remediation_details.remediation: Replace string concatenation with prepared statements
remediation_details.corrected_code_example: PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement("SELECT * FROM ? WHERE name = ?"); statement.setString(1, table); statement.setString(2, name);
remediation_details.best_practice_explanation: Prepared statements separate code from user input, preventing malicious SQL injection attacks and reducing the risk of security breaches.

findings.recommendation: Avoid shell execution with user input.

remediation_details.remediation: Use ProcessBuilder with sanitized input and avoid concatenating user input into shell commands
remediation_details.corrected_code_example: ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder("cmd", "/c", "dir"); pb.directory(new File("C:\\path\\to\\directory")); Process p = pb.start();
remediation_details.best_practice_explanation: Using ProcessBuilder instead of Runtime.exec helps prevent command injection by allowing for more control over the command and its arguments. Sanitizing input and avoiding concatenation of user input into shell commands reduces the risk of command injection attacks.
